My Journey

"Hello World" program. What started as curiosity quickly evolved into a deep love for problem-solving through code. I believe that every line of code has the potential to make someone's life easier.

Over the past 3+ years, I've had the privilege of working on diverse projects ranging from e-commerce platforms to data analytics dashboards. Each project has taught me something new and reinforced my belief that technology should serve humanity.

Philosophy

I follow the principle of "Code with Purpose" - every solution I build focuses on user experience, maintainability, and scalability. I believe in writing clean, documented code that future developers (including myself) can easily understand and build upon.
